name: Bloody Passion
source: You play a young university student in a fictional world! Throughout the story you pursue romantic relationships with other characters of the game! Besides the relationships you try to deal with a mystic encounter entering your life!
translation: 你在虚构的世界中扮演一名年轻的大学生！在整个故事中，你都在追求与游戏中其他角色的浪漫关系！除了人际关系之外，你还试图应对进入你生活的神秘遭遇！
